full.scope: All 20 supplied simulation batches, audited sequentially without training or deleting pre-existing files.
limitations: No building IDs or full simulator parameter vectors are supplied, so unique targets cannot prove independent buildings.
Sampling interval and boundary temperature histories remain unknown.
Rounded collision checking does not replace a full nearest-neighbour analysis.
No train/validation/test split or model training has been performed.
Per-batch reports retain the generic first-batch limitations from the reusable audit; this global report defines the completed scope.

neighbours.scope: Exact nearest neighbours within batch-1 zero-power rows, using temperature rounded to 0.01 degrees C.
neighbours.metric: RMS difference over the full 480-point temperature curve; power is identical (all zero).
cautions: Thresholds are exploratory, not acceptance/rejection criteria.
RMS similarity does not mean every individual reading differs by less than that threshold.
Similar observable inputs with different targets may indicate limited identifiability, not mislabeled data.
Counts are rows with a close neighbour; reciprocal pairs can occur twice.
Only the zero-power subset of batch 1 was searched; this is not a full-dataset search.

detector_tests: Repeated power is not duplicate input
coverage.training_scope: All 20 batches; full validation selection and final heldout test completed

tcn.timing_note: Sum of complete epoch times, including their validation passes; excludes any interrupted partial next epoch and checkpoint I/O.
tcn.stopping_reason: Pilot runtime cap: five completed TCN epochs, approximately ten minutes. A partial next epoch, if any, was discarded.

config.scope: Pilot on retained batch 1 only (50,000 simulations; 5% of full dataset)

grouping.method: Connected components of rounded temperature RMS <= 0.01 C within identical rounded power curves
grouping.scope: All 50,000 pilot rows; not all one million simulations

config.selection: Lowest validation macro RMSE divided by training target SD, across all six indicators
config.loss: Equal mean squared standardized log errors across all six indicators; HLC is derived from its two positive components
limitations: No building/configuration IDs; grouping nearby observable inputs cannot establish independent physical configurations.
Same heating protocols may occur in different splits with different temperature responses. This pilot estimates in-distribution performance, not unseen-protocol generalization.
Grouping threshold is an exploratory 0.01 C RMS criterion, not a proof of physical equivalence.
Sampling interval and boundary conditions remain unknown.
Single training seed and bounded epoch budget; this is not a final architecture ranking.
Used installed Python environment, not an independently uv-synchronized environment.

TCN capped at five completed epochs after observed per-epoch runtime; original maximum was 12. MLP stopped using validation patience. Unequal epoch/compute budgets prevent a definitive architecture comparison.
config.runtime_budget_note: TCN capped at five completed epochs after observed per-epoch runtime; original maximum was 12. MLP stopped using validation patience. Unequal epoch/compute budgets prevent a definitive architecture comparison.

training.finalization: Restored and independently verified best completed checkpoint after runtime cap

cpu_inference_benchmark.note: Warm forward inference only; excludes loading, preprocessing, transfers and startup. Batch throughput is not single-record latency.

training.source_snapshot_note: Exact source snapshots from the executed run. The maintained runner may gain CLI controls; snapshots retain original code identity.

full_training.test_evaluation_policy: One selected checkpoint evaluated after selection.json was written; mean baseline reported as a fixed reference. No model re-selection from test results.

config.scope: All 20 source batches; one million simulations assigned to training/validation/test or protected-pilot set-aside

grouping.method: Global same-power connected components, complete 480-point integer-temperature RMS <= 0.01 C; block-average KD-tree candidates verified on full curves
grouping.pilot_protection: All original test rows stay test. Components prioritize test then validation. Previously explored pilot rows in conflicting heldout components are set aside, not relabeled as unseen test data.
limits: Connected components can contain distant curves through chains; these are not physical building IDs.
Same heating protocol with different responses can occur in different partitions.
Protected cohorts and large components can prevent exact 80/10/10 ratios or balanced zero-power counts.

config.scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau on validation macro NRMSE, factor 0.5, patience 1
config.loss: Equal standardized log MSE over all six indicators; positive independent outputs and derived HLC
config.selection: Lowest validation macro NRMSE / training target SD; selected checkpoint evaluated on test only after selection is frozen

kernel_settings.note: Seeded fast GPU training; bitwise repeatability across runs is not guaranteed.

limitations: No physical configuration IDs or boundary histories; input-similarity groups are not building identities.
Global near-input grouping is limited to identical complete power curves and rounded temperature RMS <= 0.01 C.
Connected-component chains can produce broad groups and uneven partition sizes; protected pilot rows may be set aside to preserve heldout integrity.
Same heating protocols can occur in different partitions with different responses; unseen-protocol generalization is not established.
The earlier global quality audit inspected target validity and descriptive distributions; test prediction errors were not used for training or selection.
Single training seed; fast CUDA kernels can vary numerically. Installed environment used rather than an independently synchronized uv environment.
